reason: H0 exercises only PNG decoding through spng_decoded_image_size(), spng_decode_image(), and spng_decode_row(). It never creates an encode-only context or calls spng_encode_image(), so it cannot reach the changed encoder logic that sets ctx->pixel_size = ctx->bytes_per_pixel for SPNG_FMT_PNG or SPNG_FMT_RAW, including ihdr->bit_depth < 8 where ctx->bytes_per_pixel is set to 1.
evidence: The changed production function is spng_encode_image().
spng_encode_image() requires ctx->encode_only, ctx->stored.ihdr, fmt == SPNG_FMT_PNG, and for indexed images ctx->stored.plte.
The changed statement is `else if(fmt & (SPNG_FMT_PNG | SPNG_FMT_RAW)) ctx->pixel_size = ctx->bytes_per_pixel;`; the removed guard was `if(ihdr->bit_depth >= 8)`.
Earlier in the same function, `if(ihdr->bit_depth < 8) ctx->bytes_per_pixel = 1`, directly implicating packed sub-8-bit encoder input semantics.
H0 creates its context with `spng_ctx_new(SPNG_CTX_IGNORE_ADLER32)` and invokes decoding and metadata getter APIs only; it contains no call to spng_encode_image or any encoder setup API.
recommended_action: Add an encoder fuzz harness that creates an encode-only context, fuzzes valid IHDR combinations—especially sub-8-bit and indexed images with PLTE—supplies correctly and incorrectly sized SPNG_FMT_PNG input, and exercises both one-shot and SPNG_ENCODE_PROGRESSIVE encoding paths.
